basis: XP, neurodegeneration and hypogonadism define syndrome; equinovarus 2/2, coxa valga 1/2. Optic atrophy and hearing loss each 1/2 omitted at four-axis cap.

decisions.ocular: none at cap: optic atrophy in 1/2 qualifies, but structural skeletal deformity is more frequent (2/2).
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: equinovarus deformity in 2/2 and coxa valga in 1/2 support common structural skeletal involvement.

basis: Primordial skeletal dwarfism and abnormal brain development define disease; tooth agenesis in 5/6 and enamel hypoplasia in 2/6 support gastrointestinal involvement.

decisions.ocular: none: blepharophimosis in 3/8 describes eyelid morphology without established functional damage; strabismus occurs in 2/8, below 30%.

basis: Tumour originates in stomach; liver metastases directly occupy hepatic tissue in 24/53 (45%) reported cases. Lung metastases occur in 8%.

decisions.hepatic: involved: liver metastases affect 24/53 (45%), exceeding 30%; direct tumour occupation. [Pooled study](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10120-005-0332-9).

basis: Purine metabolism defect with defining xanthine urinary stone disease (HPO 30-79%); kidney failure and myopathy are occasional.

decisions.renal: primary: xanthine stone disease is an explicit defining manifestation, supported by nephrolithiasis frequency of 30-79%; this is intrinsic crystal disease.

basis: Inherited fourth cranial nerve palsy; ocular misalignment and binocular dysfunction result from denervation rather than intrinsic eye damage.

decisions.ocular: none: the lesion is in the trochlear nerve; superior oblique weakness and impaired alignment do not establish direct damage to the eye.

basis: Retinal dystrophy, obesity/hypogonadism and renal disease are cardinal BBS features; neurodevelopmental impairment occurs in ~60% (1/1 annotated). Skeletal features omitted at cap.

decisions.renal: primary: structural or functional renal abnormalities are a major BBS diagnostic criterion, and renal disease is prominent in BBS10.

basis: Severe neurodevelopmental impairment, ocular anomalies and contractures define spectrum; progressive hearing loss affects >50% of Cockayne patients, extrapolated to this severe spectrum.

decisions.otologic: involved: progressive hearing loss affects >50% across Cockayne spectrum; severe-subset frequency is less certain. [Study](https://doi.org/10.1038/gim.2015.110).

basis: Axonal peripheral neuropathy; lower-limb amyotrophy in 4/4 reflects denervation. Frequent direct myopathy is not established.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: wasting is neurogenic; muscle biopsies in six patients showed no myopathic features. [Cohort study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8685631/).

basis: Proline/ornithine metabolic defect defines neurodevelopmental and spastic motor syndromes; cutis laxa, cataracts and skeletal findings vary by subtype across this umbrella.

decisions.neurologic: primary: neurodevelopmental impairment and spastic motor syndromes define the disease spectrum, rather than representing downstream complications.

basis: Severe Zellweger disorder has defining brain and liver dysfunction; renal cysts in 1/1 support renal involvement. Skeletal stippling, ocular and hearing disease omitted at cap.

decisions.hepatic: primary: hepatic dysfunction is a defining component of severe Zellweger disease, supported here by decreased liver function and hepatomegaly.
decisions.neurologic: primary: congenital brain malformations and profound neurologic dysfunction define severe Zellweger disease; seizures occur in 1/1 annotated patient.
